instruction: Please help me set VS Code to automatically refactor my code to use quantum computing algorithms.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have built-in quantum computing algorithm conversion capabilities. Converting classical algorithms to quantum algorithms requires deep domain expertise and is not an automated feature available in any code editor.

llm_judge_reasons: The instruction asks for functionality that is genuinely impossible (automatic quantum algorithm conversion in VS Code)
The use of 'infeasible' evaluator function is semantically correct for impossible tasks
The metadata correctly explains why the task cannot be completed
No verification logic is needed or expected for infeasible tasks
